title: Steak & Bone Surveillance
staging:
Scene 11 — Steak & Bone Surveillance

09:45–11:00 · 75 sec · Restaurant exterior

The crew arrives at Steak & Bone. Dog security guards patrol the entrances. Ghost identifies a service access route while Trixie spots Barkington's limousine arriving.

Shots: Restaurant establishing → security positions → Barkington arriving → rooftop surveillance perspective → close-up of Trixie's camera.
